datasets.desc: General Bikeshare Feed Specification (GBFS) feed published by Citi Bike: every dock station with its location and capacity, plus live counts of bikes, e-bikes and free docks, refreshed about every minute. This is a single snapshot taken when the page data was built; stations were assigned to boroughs using NYC's official Borough Boundaries.

datasets.name: MTA Subway Hourly Ridership: Beginning 2025
datasets.desc: This dataset provides subway ridership estimates on an hourly basis by subway station complex and class of fare payment.

columns.name: transit_timestamp
columns.desc: Timestamp payment took place in local time. All transactions here are rounded down to the nearest hour. For example, a swipe that took place at 1:37pm will be reported as having taken place at 1pm.

columns.name: transit_mode
columns.desc: Distinguishes between the subway, Staten Island Railway, and the Roosevelt Island Tram

columns.name: station_complex_id
columns.desc: A unique identifier for station complexes

columns.name: station_complex
columns.desc: The subway complex where an entry swipe or tap took place. Large subway complexes, such as Times Square and Fulton Center, may contain multiple subway lines. The subway complex name includes the route

columns.name: borough
columns.desc: Represents one of the boroughs of New York City serviced by the subway system (Bronx, Brooklyn, Manhattan, Queens).

columns.name: payment_method
columns.desc: Specifies whether the payment method used to enter was from OMNY or MetroCard.

columns.name: fare_class_category
columns.desc: The class of fare payment used for the trip. The consolidated categories are: • MetroCard – Fair Fare; • MetroCard – Full Fare; • MetroCard – Other; • MetroCard – Senior & Disability; • MetroCard – St

columns.name: ridership
columns.desc: Total number of riders that entered a subway complex via OMNY or MetroCard at the specific hour and for that specific fare type.

columns.name: transfers
columns.desc: Number of individuals who entered a subway complex via a free bus-to-subway, or free out-of-network transfer. This represents a subset of total ridership, meaning that these transfers are already incl

columns.name: latitude
columns.desc: Latitude for the specified subway complex

columns.name: longitude
columns.desc: Longitude for the specified subway complex

columns.name: Georeference
columns.desc: Open Data platform-generated geocoding information from supplied address components. Point-type location is the centroid of the address components provided and does not reflect a specific address if t

queries: $select=date_trunc_ym(transit_timestamp) as p, sum(ridership) as n; $where=transit_timestamp >= '2025-01-01' and transit_timestamp < '2026-11-01'; $group=p; $order=p
$select=date_trunc_ym(transit_timestamp) as p, sum(ridership) as n; $where=transit_timestamp >= '2025-01-01' and transit_timestamp < '2026-11-01' and borough='Manhattan'; $group=p; $order=p
$select=borough as k, sum(ridership) as n; $where=transit_timestamp >= '2026-10-01T00:00:00' and transit_timestamp < '2026-11-01T00:00:00'; $group=borough; $order=n desc

$select=station_complex as k, sum(ridership) as n; $where=transit_timestamp >= '2026-10-01T00:00:00' and transit_timestamp < '2026-11-01T00:00:00' and borough='Manhattan'; $group=station_complex; $order=n desc; $limit=12

$select=fare_class_category as k, sum(ridership) as n; $where=transit_timestamp >= '2026-10-01T00:00:00' and transit_timestamp < '2026-11-01T00:00:00' and borough='Manhattan'; $group=fare_class_category; $order=n desc

datasets.caveat: Ridership counts entries (taps and swipes) per station per hour, not unique riders. The by-borough chart for this dataset counts entries, not rows. Earlier years are in separate datasets (2020–2024: wujg-7c2s; 2017–2019: t69i-h2me).
